metadata.description: A collection of Claude Skills for Posit development teams, and open-source users including tools for tidyverse workflows.

plugins.name: posit-dev
plugins.description: General-purpose developer skills useful across any language, project type, or context

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Skills for GitHub pull request workflows — creating PRs, addressing review feedback, and resolving threads

plugins.name: open-source
plugins.description: Collection of skills for open-source R and Python package developers

plugins.name: r-lib
plugins.description: Collection of skills for R package developers

plugins.name: ggsql
plugins.description: Skills for writing ggsql queries — a grammar of graphics for SQL

plugins.name: shiny
plugins.description: Collection of skills for Shiny app development

plugins.name: quarto
plugins.description: Collection of skills for Quarto document creation

plugins.name: connect
plugins.description: Skills for deploying and managing content on Posit Connect

plugins.name: hta
plugins.description: Health technology assessment and health economic evaluation in R — NICE methods, decision-analytic and multistate modelling, survival extrapolation, evidence synthesis, costing, and reporting standards

plugins.name: biostatistics
plugins.description: Applied biostatistics for clinical research in R — Bayesian regression, missing data, causal inference, prediction models, and reporting standards

plugins.name: ml-clinical
plugins.description: Machine learning on tabular clinical data in R — supervised models, explainability, clustering, and dimensionality reduction

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Vendored from obra/superpowers (MIT, Jesse Vincent) — a development methodology for coding agents: brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic debugging, code review, and skill authoring
